title: Escalate when the model invents a disallowed lane
narrative: The decision model proposes a route outside the allowed envelope. Fangore runs the router and verifies product policy rejects the invalid choice and escalates — the model cannot invent new lanes. Closes the matrix after `fangore_jev_task_route_low_confidence`.
implementation: Agentic Recipe `decision_plane` runtime (`run_decision_plane_policy`) answers a bounded route choice with envelopes. Host quality policy may override a cheap route when complexity facts demand frontier or human. Invalid routes and low confidence escalate; model signals never invent new lanes.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/invalid_route.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
